Mid-week, Jupiter sextiles Saturn in your 7th House on Thursday, shifting focus to partnerships and collaborative projects—this transit solidifies alliances through honest dialogue. Late week, the Moon squares Pluto in your 4th House Friday, stirring home-related tensions or family revelations that demand emotional honesty before weekend celebrations. Saturday's Sun trine Neptune in your 12th House softens conflicts, making evening socials deeply satisfying. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, amplifying allure and creative expression. Thursday is your worst day due to Moon square Pluto in the 4th House, exposing unresolved family dynamics. Action tip: Trust Venus's midweek invitation—it may lead to a transformative connection.
